turnout.notes: Utah turnout rows use official county standardized canvass statistics from the G24 sheet of the Aggregated Canvass Statistics 2023-Present workbook. Ballots cast are total ballots counted across the election, not presidential contest votes.

historicalBaselines.warning: Utah historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data; official Utah historical Excel/PDF artifacts are identified as replacement leads.

certifiedResults.caveat: The official Utah canvass PDF reports 1,488,494 total presidential contest votes statewide. The text-layer named candidate county columns normalized here total 1,488,010 votes, leaving a 484-vote statewide residual that is documented but not distributed to counties.

reviewCharts.warning: Utah review rows are county-level President-versus-Attorney-General comparisons from the official statewide canvass PDF. They support county-level directional screening only; they are not precinct-level scatter plots, and Attorney General is not a federal Senate comparison contest.
